spiritgiven.comments:
Switzerland, thank you so much for this amazing first game of the tournament. We thought it was a very good game, spirit wise and game wise. We want to again thank you a lot for this game and we hope to play you again this tournament.
Greetings, Netherlands Mixed :)

Italy mixed, thank you for this nice game. We gave you a 1 on fouls and body contact because our team thought the contact sometimes to
much as we told you in the Spirit circle. We do want to compliment you on your communication. Me as spirit captain and also the other players of out team thought you were very clear in calls and we liked that very much. Thank you again for this very nice and intense game and we hope to see you again this tournament and mabyr beat you then :).
Good luck NED(X)
As we have discussed in the spirit circle we both thought it wasn’t a very good game. We hope that we see u again and than have a better game. Greetings and goodluck Dutch Mixed

Canada mixed, Thank you so much for this high intensity, spirited and overal fun game. We really enjoyed playing you. As we said in the spirit circle you really did well on fouls and body contact, even in the layouts you did you barely touched us. We really liked you energy on the field but also on the sideline. Your communication was very nice and the calls were resolved very quickly. Again thank you sonmuch for this amazing game and good luck for the rest of the tournament.
Greetings NED mixed

USA X , thank you for a high intensity and good spirited game. We really enjoyed playing you and the thing that stood out was your communication, the calls that were there were resolved quickly and we liked that because that keeps you in the game better. Again thank you so much for the game and good luck with the rest of the tournament :)
Greetings NED X

Poland mixed, thank you for this game, we really enjoyed playing you and we loved your positivity and your dedication to the game. Again thank you for this match and good luck with the rest of the tournament 
Greetings
NED X

France Mixed, Thank you very much for this hard fought game. We as a team really enjoyed playing you. Spirit wise it was a very clean game, with little to no unneeded contact and nice communication. You deserved the win and we hope to see you play in the final. Thanks again and good luck
Greetings NED Mixed

Dear Latvia Mixed,
We want to thank you for this hard fought quarter final. We really liked playing you guys. Explanation for the 1, I was told by my team that some of you guys didnt know the rules around pick. And since you were running them quite often we think you should look at the rules for that. For the rest it was a clean and spirited game and we hope you do well in the rest of the tournament. 
Greetings NED Mixed

Panama, Thanks for this game, we saw some improvement from the last game but we still had some comments. For fouls and body contact, we saw improvement from the last game with less dangerous plays but on the F-matching players it was to much for us and also there was one very dangerous play that injured on of us. On fair-mindedness we thought your sideline was talking to much, as we said in the spirit circle. We do want to thank you very much and wish you good luck with your last games Ned x

Swiss Mixed, thank you for this amazing rematch, as i already said in the spirit circle it is very nice to see that your team really grew during the tournament. We really liked your positivity and your awareness with contact. Congratulations on this very deserved win and we hope to see some of you next year!
Greetings NED Mixed :)

spiritreceived.comments: It was a very good communication on and outside the field:)

Thankyou Netherlands for the game! The 1’s explanations
Fouls and Body Contact: When the first dangerous play was called we told you guys to be a little more aware of your space, but 3 more dangerous plays happened after that. 
Fair-Mindedness: We felt that you guys had a strong predisposition that you were right and that we didn’t know the rules. At the same,  there were many instances in which you guys didn’t do the hand signals on a call and then exclaimed that we didn’t fix the stuff.
The Netherlands did a great job communicating throughout the game. This was a very clean game that stayed positive from both ends throughout. We also loved the spirit circle with them at the end!

As we said in the spirit circle, when resolving calls we haven’t had the felling of being listened. Mostly male matching players weren't open-minded and were not reconsidering other perspectives. Some players don’t have sufficient  knowledge of the rules (fastcount, anatomy of the field). Thanks for the intensive game!
It was a game with high intensity. The communication was really clear and the spirit of the game was good.
If you retract something you can’t call it again.

Great game, Thankyou!! Explanations Fair-mindedness: We felt there where more than a few calls in which you were only making them to benefit your game. Communication: Your players don’t know the hand signals, several times they made the wrong signals during calls and discussions. Still thankyou for the game.
We thought there where 1 or 2 not 100% necessary calls. But all the Rest was really really nice, high spirited and we really liked to Play against you. Thank you for that Game.
